Aries.feel: The appetite to start is sharp, and nothing started will take hold.
Aries.instead: Spend it physically: train, walk fast, clear something out of the way.

Taurus.feel: Nothing is moving, and in Taurus that is rest rather than drift.
Taurus.instead: Eat properly, sit somewhere comfortable, do the slow familiar thing.
Taurus.provenance: Lilly holds the void Moon less malevolent here, where she is exalted.

Gemini.feel: Conversations circle without landing, however many of them you have.
Gemini.instead: Answer the easy messages, take notes, clear the inbox; save the conversation that has to reach a decision.

Cancer.feel: Empty, but she is in her own house, so the quiet is comfortable.
Cancer.instead: Cook, tend, be with the people you don't have to perform for.
Cancer.provenance: Lilly holds the void Moon less malevolent here, her own sign.

Leo.feel: The wish to be seen meets a room that isn't watching, and gestures go unanswered.
Leo.instead: Make the thing; the announcement will carry further on another day.

Virgo.feel: Virgo's precision is running high, and it settles most naturally on work that already exists.
Virgo.instead: A strong stretch for editing, admin, and the careful second pass — the kind of work that gets better the more attention it gets.

Libra.feel: Nothing settles the scale, and agreements made now tend not to hold.
Libra.instead: Be sociable and don't sign; repair something rather than negotiate something.

Scorpio.feel: Feeling turns inward and finds nothing to resolve itself against.
Scorpio.instead: Research rather than confrontation; whatever surfaces, look at it and leave acting on it for later.
Scorpio.provenance: The Moon is in fall in Scorpio, her least resourced placement in the tradition.

Sagittarius.feel: The aimlessness here is the pleasant kind.
Sagittarius.instead: Wander: read something wide, go somewhere, plan loosely without booking it.
Sagittarius.provenance: Lilly holds the void Moon less malevolent here, in Jupiter's sign.

Capricorn.feel: Effort finds no purchase, so work costs more than it returns.
Capricorn.instead: Do the maintenance already on the list; it needs no traction to be worth doing.
Capricorn.provenance: The Moon is in detriment in Capricorn, and void on top of it.

Aquarius.feel: Detachment goes further out than usual, and ideas find nobody to bring them to.
Aquarius.instead: Solitary, abstract work: think, sketch, read, and rejoin people when she does.

Pisces.feel: Dissolving is what this sign does anyway, so the emptiness suits it better than any other.
Pisces.instead: Rest, music, making things that need no outcome; sleep counts.
Pisces.provenance: Lilly holds the void Moon less malevolent here, Jupiter's other sign.

scope: Good for finishing, refining, and work already underway; thin for beginnings meant to last.

Sun.gift: warmth, and the nerve to be seen
Sun.shadow: needing to be the centre of it
Sun.work: put the wanting-to-be-seen into making one thing worth seeing

Moon.shadow: the mood running the day sideways
Moon.work: feel it on purpose for ten minutes, so it doesn't leak into everything

Mercury.work: write the loop down — it stops circling once it's on paper

Venus.shadow: smoothing it over instead of saying the hard thing
Venus.work: have the pleasant thing, then say the true thing — in that order

Mars.gift: nerve, and the will to finish
Mars.work: spend the edge on something physical with an end, before it finds a person

Jupiter.shadow: saying yes too big, skipping the detail
Jupiter.work: say yes to the size, then check the one detail you'd rather skip

Saturn.shadow: the gloom, the stiffening, the fear
Saturn.work: do the smallest real piece — it lifts by moving, not by solving

Uranus.shadow: restlessness, the break for its own sake
Uranus.work: change one real thing on purpose, so the restlessness has somewhere to land

Neptune.shadow: fog, drift, the story you tell yourself
Neptune.work: make something, or rest — both use the fog; deciding in it doesn't

Pluto.gift: depth, and the nerve to begin again
Pluto.work: name what you're actually trying to control, then loosen one hand

moon_void_of_course.userFacing: This is not the cleanest window for beginning something that needs momentum. It may be better for tending what is already in motion, resting, reviewing, or clearing loose ends.

moon_applying_venus.userFacing: This window has more relational and aesthetic support. Good for softening, connecting, beautifying, or making an invitation.

moon_applying_jupiter.userFacing: This window has a more expansive quality. Good for teaching, publishing, outreach, or taking a generous next step, as long as you do not overextend.

moon_applying_mars.userFacing: This window has more heat and urgency. Use it for movement, action, or cutting through avoidance; be careful with reactive communication.

moon_applying_saturn.userFacing: This window may feel heavier or more constrained. It can support discipline, structure, and finishing, but may not be the easiest time for softness or ease.

hourPrompts.moon: What needs care, nourishment, or a gentler rhythm?
hourPrompts.mercury: What needs to be named, written, sorted, or communicated?
hourPrompts.venus: What would become easier if you softened, beautified, or connected?
hourPrompts.mars: What needs courage, movement, or a clean cut?
hourPrompts.jupiter: What wants to grow, be shared, or be understood in a larger frame?
hourPrompts.saturn: What needs structure, patience, or maintenance?
hourPrompts.sun: What needs to be seen, clarified, or led?

preferredLanguage: a lighter version may fit better
